thread:
Nina: heads up - eu-north-1 apiserver p95 latency + leader-election churn starting 04:12 UTC, GPU provisioning requests stuck.
Jon: seeing lots of watch reconnects and small packet drops on the regional NAT at 04:11:30. grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/apiserver/eu-north-1
Kai: apiserver logs show accept errors and short lived leader changes. snippet:
```
E0502 04:12:05.112233 1 wrap.go:42] http: Accept error: accept tcp 0.0.0.0:6443: accept4: too many open files
I0502 04:12:07.445566 1 leaderelection.go:258] error retrieving resource lock kube-system/controller-manager: timed out waiting for the condition
```
SRE-Oncall: NetOps report - NAT gateway routed through a degraded peer for 55s, switched at 04:12:30.
Nina: controllers retried pending GPUClaims, causing a watch/list storm. FD usage hit 88% on api-2.
Jon: short mitigation: cordon 30% of flapping gpu nodes, scale apiserver 2->4, bump kube-apiserver NOFILE to 8192, increase controller-manager leaseDuration to 18s.
Kai: applied scaling and ulimit; NetOps replaced bad peer route. latency improved by 04:16.
SRE-Oncall: follow-ups: add NAT peer healthcheck to provisioner, alert when apiserver FD >75% for 3m, add jitter to provisioner backoff. filing INC-5088.
